Find and return [[Eurus]]' [[Blessed Cowbell|blessed cowbell]].

== Quest information ==

=== Objectives ===
* Search the beach near [[Mount Qinkai]] for Eurus' [[Blessed Cowbell|blessed cowbell]].
* Return the blessed cowbell to Eurus.

=== Reward ===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 750 [[Luxon faction]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* [[Luxon Totem]]

== Walkthrough ==
Simply exit [[Breaker Hollow]] to the west. The cowbell will be in the most remote [[Blue Oyster]]s just outside. Generally you won't even need to fight.

== Dialogue ==
===Initial dialogue===
; Eurus
: ''"You look somewhat heroic...perhaps you can help me? I met this nice fellow in Cantha named Bahsang. He sold me a blessed cowbell that actually wards off the plague when you use it! Handy, no? I thought so, too. Well, as I was coming back from Cantha by way of the coast, a group of kappa jumped me from out of nowhere. I'm no warrior...I admit that fear overtook me, and as I fled, I dropped my precious cowbell into a bed of '''blue oysters''' under the shadow of '''Mount Qinkai'''. What will I do if the plague returns? Without that '''blessed cowbell''' I have no way to protect myself!"''
{{offer dialog
| accept = You will have your cowbell, Eurus. I swear it.
| decline = No, seriously...who put you up to this?
| ask = Please, Cantha is rife with plague and the only inoculation is my '''blessed cowbell'''! I lost it somewhere by the '''blue oysters''' that litter the beach near '''Mount Qinkai'''. 
| indent = :: }}

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Eurus
: ''"Thank goodness you recovered that cowbell! Your absence gave me time to think...perhaps I'm being selfish, keeping this power for myself. I have never seen anything like this cowbell, and I do myself and every member of my clan a disservice if I don't use it to protect as many of us from the plague as possible. It is often said among my people that a great reaver guides us all to the next life, digging through the sky of jade and leading the dead to the great, wide sea in the stars. With this cowbell, I will show them that we have no need to fear the reaver."''

== Notes ==
{{Anomaly| The quest star and the actual location of the [[Blue Oyster]]s do not always line up.}}

== Trivia ==
* "[[w:More cowbell|More Cowbell]]" is a reference to a Saturday Night Live skit with [[w:Christopher Walken|Christopher Walken]]. One of the lines from the skit was "I got a fever, and the only prescription...is more cowbell!"; similarly, Eurus believes the cowbell is his only protection from the plague. The "blue oysters" one must search through are a reference to the band name [[w:Blue Öyster Cult|Blue Öyster Cult]] and the final line of the reward dialogue refers to the title of the Blue Öyster Cult song involved in the skit, "[[w:(Don't Fear) The Reaper|(Don't Fear) The Reaper]]". The lines "perhaps I'm being selfish" and "I do myself and every member of my clan a disservice" parody Will Ferrell's impassioned speech near the end of the skit.
